deadline.value: August 2027 (Semester 1) intake closes January 31, 2027 (application window October 1 – January 31; January intake closes July 31).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for biology (ETS discontinued Biology and Biochemistry Subject Tests).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: NTU strongly recommends contacting a potential supervisor before applying; otherwise the School assigns a supervisor based on research interests.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended that you seek out a potential supervisor prior to submitting your application. Alternatively, if you have not identified one, the School will appoint a supervisor based on your research interests.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible on a competitive basis for the NTU Research Scholarship (S$3,000/month for international students, plus up to S$500/month after passing the Qualifying Examination, and annual tuition fee coverage for up to 4 years; S$3,400 PR / S$3,800 Singapore Citizen), as well as the Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship and Provost Graduate Award (S$4,300/month international).
funding.quote: NTU offers a wide range of scholarships for full-time Ph.D. studies to Singapore citizens, Singapore permanent residents and international applicants.

also.quote: The NTU Research Scholarship is awarded to outstanding graduate students for research. | In addition to the monthly stipend, the award also covers the annual tuition fee.

entry_route.value: Direct PhD entry from a relevant bachelor's degree with at least 2nd Upper Honours or equivalent.
entry_route.quote: Applicants from overseas universities must have a relevant Bachelor’s degree with at least 2nd Upper Honours or better, or the equivalent.

gre_general.value: SBS explicitly states that GRE and GATE scores are optional and need not be provided for overseas applicants.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) and Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) scores are optional and need not be provided.

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS may be waived if the applicant provides documentary proof that English was used as the medium of instruction during tertiary studies.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL/IELTS scores are required if the Bachelor's degree was not conducted in English. These may be waived if the applicant can provide documentary proof that English was used as the medium of instruction during tertiary studies.

notes: SBS PhD applicants are required to submit a short video essay in addition to standard supporting documents.
